Yancey used these instruments to combine soulful samples with innovative percussive loops and future-sounding synth tones to create a unique style of music that would become a signature of the Native Tongue and resurgent soul movements in hip-hop and R&B music throughout the 1990s and early 2000s.
a steady wobble, which was unfailingly musical and rich in details—shuffling hi-hats, oddly placed handclaps, spacious drum loops with drastically reshaped samples of tracks both obscure and obvious.
His innovative approach to rhythm, often referred to as "Dilla Time," introduced a unique groove that blurred the lines between traditional straight and swung beats.
His beats often evoke a sense of nostalgia, blending joy and melancholy in a way that feels both timeless and contemporary.
His unconventional drum programming continues to inspire producers, shaping the future of hip-hop and beyond.
His signature song style, marked by unquantized drums, soulful sample chops, and an organic swing, redefined hip-hop production and beyond.
His legacy is deeply tied to his innovative sense of rhythm, often described as "drunken drums" or "offbeat perfection."

Dilla's ability to push sonic boundaries is on full display in "Move." The beat constantly evolves, shifting from spacey funk to driving percussion, all while keeping that undeniable bounce.

One of hip-hop's most admired and innovative producers of the 2000s until his untimely death.

It's the seamlessness of Dilla's productions that really became his calling card after 2003's Jaylib release, Champion Sound – how samples were incorporated as if they'd always been there, like these were the originals and, somehow, James Brown had beamed himself into the future (and back again) for his My Thang single of 1974.
Motifs both superbly weird and instantly recognisable rise and fall, vocals snatched from a genre-spanning variety of sources acting as pivots for Dilla's original contributions to see-saw atop of.
Dilla had a unique Midas touch which has reached well beyond his own, tragically short lifetime.
